title: Rediscovering Biomarkers for the Diagnosis and Early Treatment Response in NEN (REBORN)
official: Rediscovering Biomarkers for the Diagnosis and Early Treatment Response in NEN. REBORN Study
summary: This is a multicentre, controlled, observational prospective study on new biomarkers, as immune profiling, angiogenetic markers and circRNA from TEPs in the diagnosis and in the evaluation of treatment response in pulmonary and gastro-entero-pancreatic NENs.
